name: Event Gallery
description: The 38-photo event grid. It was 40 until two tiles turned out to be byte-identical duplicates of two others; the wall is a single composition, so a repeat in it is visible to a visitor and the duplicates were deleted rather than reordered. Since the media-manifest change each photo's alt comes from src/data/media.json via altFor, falling back to the positional 'Harvard in Tech event photo N' only for an image the manifest has no record of. The frame looks identical either way — alt is not visible — so the alt behavior is pinned by src/lib/media.test.ts rather than by this capture. The manifest is deliberately NOT seeded here: the capture pipeline's seed builder requires array-of-rows tables and rejects the object-valued 'media' singleton.
